## Spec-driven checklist

- [ ] Feature spec exists (`specs/NNNN-slug.md`) and has status `approved`
- [ ] Tests written before implementation (TDD), failing first
- [ ] `hassfest` validation passes locally (or the reason for a known failure is documented)
- [ ] No secrets committed (tokens, keys, credentials)
- [ ] Skeptic review completed: verdict `APPROVED` (or `NITS` only)
- [ ] Live actions against a lock (unlock/lock) only after explicit user confirmation

## Commit style

Conventional Commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, `test:`, `chore:`, `refactor:`).
